requirements.observations: Front and rear show matching centered semicircular arch openings and two grounded legs; side views show the continuous depth; top and bottom confirm the rounded footprint and through-tunnel; both isometrics show a single continuous crown with smooth arch walls and no unintended holes, fragments, or merged features.

views.observations: Centered arch, equal-width legs, rounded outer corners, and full crown are visible without clipping or unintended openings.
Rear silhouette matches the front with a centered open arch and symmetric grounded legs.
Left side shows the full rectangular depth profile with rounded vertical edges and no stray geometry.
Right side matches the left; the body is continuous across its depth and unclipped.
Top view shows one clean 80 by 30 mm rounded-rectangle footprint with consistent corners.
Bottom view shows two connected-foot regions separated by the centered through-tunnel; the visible inner arch surface is consistent with the intended opening.
The rounded monolithic bridge, smooth centered arch, two legs, continuous crown, and through-depth opening are all clearly resolved.
Opposing isometric confirms the same continuous crown and tunnel exit with no hidden fragments or unintended holes.
